attributes.name: ypy-ws:connect
attributes.description: Opens a WebSocket to the URL when the element's `ypy-trigger` fires (default `load`). `http(s)://` and relative URLs are converted to `ws(s)://`. A text message is swapped into the target as HTML; a JSON message swaps its `content` field and may carry `target`, `swap` and `select`. Other JSON is only available to listeners. The socket reconnects with backoff and closes with the element.

attributes.name: ypy-ws:send
attributes.description: Sends the element's values over the WebSocket of the nearest `ypy-ws:connect` ancestor, as JSON with a `headers` member. It collects form values and `ypy-vals` like a request. The default trigger is `submit` for a form, `change` for a field and `click` otherwise; `ypy-trigger` overrides it.

attributes.name: ypy-ws-connect
attributes.description: Legacy spelling of `ypy-ws:connect`. The extension copies it to the new name and warns in the console.

attributes.name: ypy-ws-send
attributes.description: Legacy spelling of `ypy-ws:send`. The extension copies it to the new name and warns in the console.

events.name: ypy:ws:before:connection
events.description: Fires before a socket is created, and again before each reconnect. Call `evt.preventDefault()` or set `detail.connection.cancelled = true` to stop; a `ypy:ws:close` event with reason `cancelled` follows.

events.name: ypy:ws:after:connection
events.description: Fires when the socket opens. Queued outgoing messages are sent right after it.

events.name: ypy:ws:close
events.description: Fires when the socket closes. `detail.reason` is `closed` (with the close `code`), `cancelled` or `removed`; `code` is `null` for the last two, and also for a `closed` that YPY did itself because the socket was silent for `ws.heartbeat` or the page came back.

events.name: ypy:ws:error
events.description: Fires on a socket error, a failed send, a full outgoing queue, or a send with no open connection. `detail.error` is an `Event`, an `Error` or a message string; `detail.connection` is absent when there is no connection.

events.name: ypy:ws:before:message:outgoing
events.description: Fires before a message is sent. Edit `detail.message.headers`, `detail.message.values` or set `detail.message.data` to send raw data instead of JSON. Cancel it, or set `detail.cancelled = true`, to drop the message. `detail.waitUntil(promise)` delays the send.

events.name: ypy:ws:after:message:outgoing
events.description: Fires after a message was written to the socket.

events.name: ypy:ws:before:message:incoming
events.description: Fires when a message arrives, before it is swapped. Cancel it, or set `detail.cancelled = true`, to ignore it (the data stays available to this listener). `detail.waitUntil(promise)` delays processing.

events.name: ypy:ws:after:message:incoming
events.description: Fires after an incoming message was processed and any content swapped.

config.name: ws
config.description: Defaults of the ypy-ws extension. A single element overrides them with `ypy-config='{"ws":{...}}'`.

config.name: ws.reconnect
config.description: Reconnect after the socket closes with one of `reconnectCodes`.

config.name: ws.reconnectCodes
config.description: Close codes that trigger a reconnect. Any other code ends the connection.

config.name: ws.reconnectDelay
config.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`.

config.name: ws.reconnectMaxDelay
config.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string.

config.name: ws.reconnectMaxAttempts
config.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default.

config.name: ws.reconnectJitter
config.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off.

config.name: ws.pauseOnBackground
config.description: Close the socket while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again.

config.name: ws.heartbeat
config.description: Close the socket and open it again when no message arrives for this long, in ms or as an interval string such as `45s`. The browser does not show protocol ping frames to the page, so the server has to send a message (any text) now and then. It catches a socket that a sleeping phone left open: it neither fails nor closes, so the reconnect would never run. The watch also covers a connection that never opens. Off by default (`0`). It reconnects only when `ws.reconnect` is on; otherwise the socket is closed. When the page is shown again (`pageshow` from the back/forward cache, `online`, a tab that is visible again) a socket silent for longer than this is opened again at once, a wait for the next attempt is skipped, and a socket that `pagehide` closed is opened again.

config.name: ws.maxOutgoingMessagesQueueSize
config.description: How many messages wait for the socket to open. A message sent when the queue is full fires `ypy:ws:error`.
